summary: Alex Kidd entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World
entries.definitive_edition: SEGA AGES Alex Kidd in Miracle World for original route; DX as remake comparison

emulation.emulator: Genesis Plus GX / MAME only if official route is unavailable
emulation.notes: Use official SEGA AGES route where possible; document emulator/core if used.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Master System hardware or accurate Master System emulation

primary.version: SEGA AGES Alex Kidd in Miracle World
primary.why: The SEGA AGES release is the best current official route for the original Master System game, while Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX is a remake with new graphics and expanded/changed content. Use DX as a comparison route, not a replacement for the 1986 original.
primary.how_to_play: Use SEGA AGES Alex Kidd in Miracle World on Switch for the original route. Record region/version, mode, rewind/ranking use, controller, Master System original comparison, and whether DX was also played.

secondary.platform: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX
secondary.exclusive_content: HD remake with new levels and presentation changes
secondary.what_to_play: Use separately if documenting the remake.
secondary.why: DX changes enough to be a separate comparison route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current official original-game route with quality-of-life options.
all_releases.reason: primary: best practical route for the original game.

all_releases.platform: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX on PC / consoles
all_releases.fidelity: Modern remake with new graphics, levels, and gameplay adjustments.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: SEGA AGES preserves the original route; DX is a remake with changed and expanded content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record mode/rewind use and do not merge DX remake changes into the original route.
